answer: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer; you can have it fixed free at a dealer for your car's brand first, but you don't have to. If your car has hail damage, list it on the damage disclosure form NW-DMG-1 before the inspection, because disclosed damage is already priced into your offer, while undisclosed damage can lower it. However, the help center doesn't cover whether we buy a car with an open insurance claim, so please contact a store about that part.
